context: Two coworkers grumble about morning traffic during the rainy season
purpose: Teach: 落ちる/避ける/下がる/決まる/梅雨/渋滞/厳しく/地理

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: おはよう。今朝の渋滞、本当にひどかったよ。
lines.en: Morning. The traffic this morning was really brutal.
lines.style: Tired, slightly grumbling greeting between familiar coworkers.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: わかる。梅雨に入ってから毎朝こんな感じだよね。
lines.en: I get it. Ever since the rainy season started, every morning is like this.
lines.style: Sympathetic, weary agreement with a soft sigh.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 雨が強くなると速度も下がるし、事故も増えるしね。
lines.en: When the rain gets heavy, speeds drop and accidents go up too.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact venting, listing complaints in order.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 私、いつも裏道を通って渋滞を避けるようにしてるんだけど、今日は無理だった。
lines.en: I always try to take the back roads to avoid the traffic, but today it was impossible.
lines.style: Frustrated confession tinged with quiet resignation today.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: この辺の地理に詳しくないと、抜け道なんて分からないよ。
lines.en: If you don't know the local geography well, you can't find shortcuts.
lines.style: Half-joking complaint with envious admiration., voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 上司、遅刻には厳しく言うのに、こんな日は何も考えてくれないよね。
lines.en: The boss is strict about being late, but on days like this he doesn't consider anything.
lines.style: Quietly bitter grumble, lowered voice between colleagues.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 本当それ。やる気も落ちるし、評価まで下げられたらたまらないよ。
lines.en: Seriously, that. Motivation drops, and if our evaluations get lowered too, I can't take it.
lines.style: Exasperated agreement, leaning into shared misery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 来週から在宅勤務になるって決まったらしいよ。梅雨の間だけでも助かるね。
lines.en: Apparently it's been decided we'll work from home starting next week. Even just during the rainy season, that helps.
lines.style: Brightening news delivered with relieved optimism.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: それ、今朝一番うれしいニュースだよ。
lines.en: That's the best news I've heard all morning.
lines.style: Genuinely relieved, finally cracking a small smile.
